title: console: the bulk-action confirm step still lists the affected records as raw ids for a plain `bulkActions` script action on 18.0.0-next.0 (objectui pin 1fb1ced, which already carries #12119's fix for #12105)
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect, reproduced in a browser.
`reach:` the console list selection bar → a bulk action's confirm step, measured on the HotCRM Leads list.
Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01BCDqr1DqnQjEh5jA9gGkUG`) from objectstack-ai/hotcrm's v18 test pass (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2093, finding 12). ⛔ Not a claim. File-at-destination, for triage.
Reader: the objectui triage seat.
Dedupe: semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, "bulk action confirm dialog affected records listed as raw ids instead of record titles" → 10 hits. **#12105** (closed `completed` 2026-10-11 by PR #12119) reported "the confirm step lists raw ids" for a promoted action with a field-backed param.

**Why this is not a pin lag:** `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.0's release commit `d889448b` pins objectui `1fb1ced` (`.objectui-sha`), and REST compare shows `1fb1ced` is 82 commits ahead of #12119's merge commit `29b9949025fc`. The fix is in the shipped console, and this path still shows ids. So #12119 covered the field-backed path, not this one.

## What happens

On Leads, tick 2 rows, use the selection bar's "Add to Campaign", pick a campaign, and click Next.
- **The confirm step reads:** "Affected records (2): • NZlnBCoFRGzxCw4O • Y-5E63TwqDGmfwfW".
- **Expected:** the record titles ("Mira Costa - Atlas Construction", "Kai Watanabe - Coral Reef Hotels").

The app declares only `bulkActions: ['create_campaign']` (objectstack-ai/hotcrm `src/sales/views/lead.view.ts`), a script action with no field-backed param.

Screenshot: [12-bulk-action-confirm-lists-raw-record-ids.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f99218e05b422543e90a6c39214cc9be3095d3d8/qa/2026-10-13-v18-pass/12-bulk-action-confirm-lists-raw-record-ids.png).

## Ask

Every bulk-action confirm step names the affected records by their display title, whatever the action's param shape is, and is pinned for this plain script-action path.
